lines.en: I come near first, then speak
My footsteps lag behind my shadow
I move toward the gap under the door
The hall is long, and I do not mind

lines.zh: 我每一步都踩在你刚走过的地方
lines.en: I step where you just stepped

lines.zh: 我隔着一扇门跟你说话
lines.en: I talk to you through a closed door
I stop at the foot of the stairs

lines.zh: 我慢慢移到你的正后方
lines.en: I slide to a spot right behind you
I walk, and you cannot hear it
I simply stand here, watching you
I am not ready to scream yet

lines.zh: 这间屋子里的空气有点重
lines.en: The air in this room is heavy

lines.zh: 我的声音已经在喉咙里了
lines.en: My voice is already in my throat
So quiet, and the quiet is wrong
I am counting the things in your room
I have one thing to say
If you do not turn, I keep standing

lines.zh: 我的手指在墙上轻轻敲
lines.en: My fingers tap lightly on the wall

lines.zh: 这地方太亮了，我不喜欢
lines.en: This place is too bright, I dislike it

You may speak first
We are finally face to face
You look at me, and I have not screamed yet
Do not rush off, let us talk a moment
I would like to ask you one question first
I quite like the look on your face

lines.zh: 你听得出我的声音不对吗
lines.en: Can you tell my voice is wrong
You had better hear me out

What I have to say is simple

lines.zh: 你身后的门已经关上了
lines.en: The door behind you has already closed
I am polite, truly
Do not make a sound yet
Your breathing has gone shallow
We still have a little time
While I speak, do not move
You will remember this sentence

lines.zh: 你眼睛往哪边看，我都知道
lines.en: I know which way your eyes go
I am almost finished
I will stop talking at three
Stand and listen, do not sit
You actually interrupted me
I withdraw to the far wall
This pain does not stop me talking
You hit me, and I smiled
My voice caught for a moment
I wipe the corner of my mouth
Am I finished speaking
I will keep this in mind

lines.zh: 我不生气，我更有兴趣了
lines.en: I am not angry, I am more interested
Your hands really are strong
You need not bring me anything

lines.zh: 递东西的手，我要握一下
lines.en: The hand that offers, I will hold
I do not eat this, I only speak
Let me look at what you hold
Put it away, I am not taking it
You think that makes me leave
I heard your good intentions
Set it down, and I will say one more thing
This is not a trade
I lack not things, I lack a listener
You bumped into me, how polite

lines.zh: 我一下就贴到了你旁边
lines.en: In one moment I am right beside you
This is close enough to talk

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到了我的袖子
lines.en: Your shoulder brushed my sleeve

lines.zh: 我扶住你的肩，凑近说话。
lines.en: I steady your shoulder and lean in to speak.
I am already in front of you

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我仍在原地。
lines.en: You back to the wall; I am still here.
We are this close together
You carry warmth
That bump counts as a greeting

lines.zh: 我不需要同伴，我需要听众
lines.en: I need no companion, I need an audience
My kin speak hideously

lines.zh: 我更喜欢一个人站在角落里
lines.en: I prefer standing alone in a corner
Two voices at once would be too loud

lines.zh: 我找的不是伴，是一个留下来的
lines.en: I look not for a mate, but for someone who stays

lines.zh: 另一个我，也在别人的屋里
lines.en: Another of me is in someone else's house
Even I fear my kin's screaming

lines.zh: 并排站着，也是一种交流
lines.en: Standing side by side is a kind of exchange

lines.zh: 我说话的时候，它会插嘴
lines.en: It would interrupt while I speak
We need not stand too close
I pick it up, then set it down
This is not mine
I nudge it with a fingertip

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我替你看着
lines.en: I will watch what you dropped

lines.zh: 捡起来的时候，你看着我
lines.en: While I pick it up, you watch me

lines.zh: 我拿到手里，又觉得没意思
lines.en: I take it, then lose interest
It landed with a bright little sound
The thing is yours, the words are mine
I no longer need these
I set it back where it was
First I speak. Then I scream.
This corner is just right
You are alone, how nice
I begin from this direction

lines.zh: 我听见你刚才把门关上
lines.en: I heard you close the door
Only you and I in this room
I am already ahead of you

lines.zh: 你看不见的那一面，是我
lines.en: The side you cannot see, that is me
I am about to start speaking
The path you chose has no one else
I am squared to your back
Turn around, and you'll see me.
This moment is good
I am waiting for you to put the lamp down
From now on, I follow only you
Listen, I clear my throat first
I keep talking from just behind you
The faster you walk, the happier I am

lines.zh: 我说的每一句你都听见了
lines.en: You hear every word I say
My hand rests on the doorframe
You need not answer me

lines.zh: 走廊的灯在我身后灭了
lines.en: The hall light dies behind me

lines.zh: 你一停，尖叫声就卡在喉咙。
lines.en: When you stop, the scream sticks in my throat.
A few more sentences to finish

lines.zh: 你越跑越靠近我的声音
lines.en: The more you run, the closer you come to my voice
I have counted every door

lines.zh: 我们聊完了，接下来是尖叫。
lines.en: We're done talking; now comes the scream.
One turn and I am against you
I am pleased with this distance

lines.zh: 你不用回头看，听着就行
lines.en: Do not look back, just listen

I speak right beside you, very near

Can you hear it

lines.zh: 尖叫声里，我抓住你手腕。
lines.en: Through the screaming, I grab your wrist.
My hand clamps your shoulder

lines.zh: 尖叫声从我喉咙里出来
lines.en: The scream comes out of my throat
That is not a blow, it is a greeting
I shove you flat against the wall
Your ears must be ringing
I come close to the back of your neck
That sound leaves you unable to move

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，我感觉得到
lines.en: I can feel your hand shaking
That grab was a courtesy
Once I finish screaming, I will talk again
Can you still run now

lines.zh: 这间屋子空着，我进来了
lines.en: This room was empty, so I came in
I say one thing first, then come closer

lines.zh: 我的声音先从墙里出来
lines.en: My voice comes out of the wall first
I start from the far end of the hall
No one answered the door here
I stand in the shadow behind the door
Your lamp does not reach this spot

lines.zh: 我进来的时候没有声音
lines.en: I made no sound coming in
This corner is just enough for me

The first thing you hear is breathing

lines.zh: 我选了这间有人的屋子
lines.en: I picked this room because it had someone

lines.zh: 我站到你屋里的家具后面
lines.en: I take a place behind your furniture

lines.zh: 你的影子在地上多了一道
lines.en: A second shadow joins yours on the floor
I watch you through the gap in the door

lines.zh: 这一间我打算多待一会儿
lines.en: I plan to stay in this one a while
Once I speak, you will know
The firelight lit up my face
I fell, and the voice cut off
Water plugged my throat

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的声音盖住了
lines.en: The blast drowned out my voice

lines.zh: 飞来的东西打断了我一句
lines.en: Something flying cut off a sentence

lines.zh: 我越来越虚弱，说话没力气
lines.en: I weaken, and my voice loses force

lines.zh: 虚空里没有墙，我贴不住
lines.en: No walls in the void, I cannot cling
